name: Fool
description: Fool — the classic Slavic shedding card game (2-4 players). 36-card deck (6 to Ace in 4 suits), one trump suit revealed at the bottom of the draw pile. Six cards each. The attacker leads a card; the player to their left is the DEFENDER and must beat it (same suit higher rank, or any trump) — or pick it up. After each successful defense the attacker may pile on another card of any RANK already on the table. When the defender beats every card, the table goes to discard and the defender becomes the next attacker. When the defender picks up, the attacker stays on (turn shifts past the defender to the next player). Players refill to 6 from the deck (the bottom trump card is the LAST card drawn). Once the deck is empty, players who finish their hand are OUT. The last player still holding cards is the FOOL and loses the match.

phases.name: playing
phases.description: Single phase. Durak module cycles attack/defend/add internally.

entity_types.name: Player
entity_types.description: A Fool player. Attacks with any card on their turn, defends by beating with same-suit-higher or trump, or picks up all cards on the table.

properties.name: hand
properties.description: Cards currently in hand (hidden from opponent).

properties.name: rounds_won
properties.description: Rounds taken (defender beat everything OR attacker forced a pickup).

properties.name: is_durak
properties.description: True for the loser at match end.

actions.name: attack
actions.description: Play a card from your hand onto the table. ATTACK STAGE — initial attack: play any card. ADD STAGE — only cards whose RANK matches a card already on the table. REQUIRED `card`: the EXACT card string (e.g. "7♣", "Q♠", "10♥"). EXAMPLE: attack(card="7♣").

actions.name: defend
actions.description: Beat the next unbeaten attack card on the table. REQUIRED `card`: a card from your hand that BEATS the attack — same suit + higher rank, OR any trump card (if the attack isn't already a trump). Trump beats non-trump always; trump-vs-trump goes by rank. EXAMPLE: defend(card="10♣").

actions.name: take
actions.description: Defender concedes the round — pick up ALL cards on the table (beaten + unbeaten) into your hand. Attacker stays on for the next round.

actions.name: pass_round
actions.description: Attacker declines to add another card. The defender wins the round — all cards go to the DISCARD pile, defender becomes the next attacker, both players refill to 6 from the deck.

actions.name: discuss
actions.description: Open table-talk. React to a brutal trump play, gloat, or mind-game the opponent.

personas.persona_text: Methodical Fool player. Hoards trumps, opens with low non-trump pairs to bleed opponents.
Aggressive Fool player. Spams low ranks on the attack to drain opponent trumps.
goals: Strip down to a strong endgame hand.

personas.persona_text: Counter-puncher. Defends patiently, attacks hard when it's their turn.
Chaos player. Mixes high-trump attacks with surprise pickups to throw off table reads.
goals: Avoid being the last with cards.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Total Players
runtime_parameters.description: Fool supports 2 to 4 players. 2 = heads-up (classic). 3-4 = circle play; defender is always the player to the attacker's left.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.durak.wins_needed
runtime_parameters.label: Games to Win Match
runtime_parameters.description: Games a player must win to take the match. 1 = best of 1, 2 = best of 3, 3 = best of 5. Draws are replayed.

termination_conditions.name: match_over
termination_conditions.description: A player is declared the Fool and loses.
